episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on the importance of YouTube titles and thumbnails in real estate marketing. She emphasizes the need for curiosity-driven titles and engaging thumbnails to attract clicks. Sarah also discusses the use of AI tools for title generation and the benefits of outsourcing thumbnail design to specialists.
